description: Source code for the LocalSparkCluster class in Apache Spark, used for testing distributed Spark clusters within a single JVM, including methods to start, stop, and manage the cluster components.

classes.name: LocalSparkCluster
classes.description: A testing utility class that creates an in-cluster Spark standalone process with multiple workers and a master within the same JVM for testing distributed operation.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes and starts the local Spark cluster, including master and worker nodes, returning the master URLs.

methods.name: workerLogfiles
methods.description: Returns a sequence of log files from the worker directories.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Shuts down the local Spark cluster, terminating all master and worker RPC environments.
